h:
ComfyUI 的此工作流程旨在将所有 FLUX1.Tools 组合在一起，用于 1) 图像 - 2) 修复 - 3) 修复 - 和 4) 建筑图像上的 img2vid 生成。可能对其他人也有用。工作流程从深度生成生成图像（在模型加载器（第 I 部分）中的 lora/模型之间切换或自定义，例如精明），然后可以在流程结束时将输出发送到 cogvideox 之前进行 In-/Outpainted。包括一些基本图像输入的示例。

有关我如何使用它的视频可以在这里观看：

变化

_______

v0.55_241219

- 在配置中添加了img2video“模式4”，现在启用基本图像输入到视频输出（建议为此关闭图像输出）

- 在 cogvideox CONFIG 中添加了选择摄像机运动，第二部分中的预定义提示现在可以通过 NimVideo 创建的摄像机运动 Lora 进行运动（链接如下）

- 添加了 MOTION LORA STRENGTH，测试结果为 0.6-0.8，有时 1.0 有效。添加到已用资源

- 进一步简化了图像输入，现在除了 redux 之外的所有内容都可以通过基本图像输入获得

v0.5_241213

- 修复了修复，可见的遮罩似乎已被删除（模糊），正确的输出现在将显示在预览/保存节点中咳嗽

- 添加了更简单的图像调整大小分辨率设置，默认设置为 1920 像素（比例保持不变）

- REDUX STRENGTH 现在可以通过 CONFIG 轻松调整

- LORA STRENGTH 现在可以通过 CONFIG 轻松调整

- 为视频输出添加了自动宽高比，根据您的输入，它现在创建横向/纵向

- 简化视频输出，流程节点移至 COGVIDEOX OUTPUT，现在可在 rg Three 的快速旁路器中一键启用/禁用

- 组合输入和外涂以节省一些空间

- 添加了标准“保存图像”节点（低质量/LQ：jpg 72 dpi，高质量/HQ：png 300 dpi 包含元数据/工作流程）

v0.4_241129

- 添加了正确的修复，现在你的图像在 3-4 次修复后不会被炸毁。

- FLUX1.Redux 现在是其中的一部分（黑色节点）

- 在图像生成提示之间轻松切换

- 优化的工作流程

v0.3_241122

- 初始版本

请注意，此工作流程需要大量 VRAM 资源（如视频所示）。

o.en:
This Workflow for ComfyUI is designed to have ALL the FLUX1.Tools combined for using it for 1) image- 2) inpainting- 3) outpainting- and 4) img2vid-generation on Architectural Imagery. Might be of use to others here too. The Workflow generates images from Depth-Generation (switch between lora/model in the Model Loader (Section I) or customize e.g. to canny), outputs can then be In-/Outpainted before being send to cogvideox at the end of the process. Some Examples for BASE IMAGE INPUT included.

A video for how i use it can be seen here:

CHANGES

_______

v0.55_241219

- added img2video "mode 4" in CONFIG, now enables BASE IMAGE INPUT to VIDEO OUTPUT (recommend to turn off IMAGE OUTPUT for that)

- added SELECT CAMERA MOVEMENT to cogvideox CONFIG, pre defined prompts from section II now enable the movement through Camera Motion Lora created by NimVideo (link below)

- added MOTION LORA STRENGTH, tested best at 0.6-0.8, sometimes 1.0 working. Added to used resources

- further simplified IMAGE INPUTS, now everything but redux is available through BASE IMAGE INPUT

v0.5_241213

- fixed Inpainting, visible seems from masking removed (blurred), the correct output will be shown in the preview/save node nowcough

- added easier Setting for IMAGE RESIZE RESOLUTION, default set to 1920 Pixel (proportions remain)

- REDUX STRENGTH now can be easily adjusted from CONFIG

- LORA STRENGTH now can be easily adjusted from CONFIG

- added auto-aspect for video Output, depending on your input it now creates landscape/portrait

- simplified video output, process-nodes moved to COGVIDEOX OUTPUT and now it is a one click enable/disable in rgthree's fast bypasser

- combined INPUTS FOR IN- & OUTPAINTING to safe some space

- added standard SAVE IMAGE nodes (Low Quality/LQ: jpg 72 dpi, High Quality/HQ: png 300 dpi CONTAINING METADATA/WORKFLOW)

v0.4_241129

- added PROPER Inpainting, now your Images don't get fried after 3-4 Inpaintings.

- FLUX1.Redux now part of this (BLACK nodes)

- easily switch between Prompts for image Generation

- optimized workflows

v0.3_241122

- initial release

Please be aware that this workflow demands high ressources in terms of VRAM (as shown in the video).
